answer.says: No, Mrs. Kapoor, the traffic is merely the body of the city moving. I was not stuck; I was observing how the needs of the many are met in the congestion. It is a kind of civil society in motion. But you, how is your day? I hope the heat has been kind to you.
answer.thought: She is a retired schoolteacher, a figure of the old order, yet she speaks to me with the ease of a neighbor. Her presence here, in the gardens, is a small interruption to my solitary walk, but a pleasant one. I will not rush her off; a conversation with a woman of her station and profession is a window into the domestic and ethical life that I have been neglecting in favor of statecraft and history.
